content.text:
Resubmitted with both defects cured.

**Changes made in response to the verifier:**

1. **Minimality — duplicated exclusivity removed.** The § 11.2(A) tail "and no other termination fee, liquidated damages or penalty" is deleted. Exclusivity is now enacted once only, in the new final sentence of § 13.5: "The Termination for Convenience Fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer under this Agreement."

2. **Intent — contradiction repaired.** Rather than renaming the charge (which would have forced collateral edits at five cross-references), I made the tightest conforming edit: deleting "Customer or " from the § 11.1 scoping sentence, which now reads "…shall apply to any early termination of this Agreement other than pursuant to an Event of Default on the part of M&I or pursuant to Section 11.3 below." § 11.1 and revised § 11.2(A) now agree that the fee is owed on a Customer-default termination, and § 11.1 plus § 11.2(B) still impose no fee on an M&I default — so no untouched commercial protection was lost.

3. **Housekeeping confirmed.** "Estimated Remaining Value" appears only at p0039, p0187 and p0189; it is left intact and merely unused. The rationale now states deliberately that the cap's temporal anchor is the Effective Date of Termination rather than the definition's "event giving rise to termination rights."

Level remains fallback (three months' fees, single fee, sole liquidated amount); preferred is not pursued because § 13.5 still characterises the fee as liquidated damages, and that is noted rather than redlined.
